body.statement: For odd m and 0<=j<K, exactly 2^(K-j-1) of the 2^K lifts have nu2(a+mk)=j; and the digits so produced are independent while the cylinder still resolves the orbit.

body.method: Exhaustive verification of the counting lemma; then total-variation distance between the measured joint law of d consecutive digits and the product of its marginals, swept over K to separate truncation from dependence.
